correctness.rationale: For monic squarefree quartics with disjoint roots, independent branch squareclasses show the sextic is geometrically integral and its normalization has genus five. The affine Jacobian equations leave only y=0 and h=P-Q=0, with exact local form y'^2-t^(2e). Projective homogenization has fixed A3 at (0:1:0), and when deg h<3 a second A_(2(3-deg h)-1) at (1:0:0); other infinity intersections are smooth. Formal unit square roots are available in characteristic zero or >=5. The exact seven-case witness script reproduces squarefreeness/disjointness, coefficient expansions and delta conservation, and is not used as proof of universal assertions. All singularity deltas sum to five.
